capabilities: add a link to the current note at the bottom of selected notes
pick any file to link via the quick switcher
run the action from the command palette or a hotkey
extras: Compatibility note only mentions Obsidian 0.9.10, an old version, so current compatibility is unclear.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to create incoming links in other notes in bulk; linking back requires opening each note and adding the link by hand.
summary: Command-based plugin that adds a link to the currently open note at the bottom of one or more selected notes.
